description: Verify that DUT-emit UDP datagram carries the caller-specified Source Port (RFC 768 'User Interface' MUST). Mirror of FIELDS_01 but anchored under §User Interface with a per-case src_port for wire disambiguation
approach:
[Objective]
Same mechanic as FIELDS_01 — the user interface src_port must reach the wire — but anchored to the User Interface section of RFC 768 and using a per-case src_port so wire frames are disambiguated from FIELDS_01 / _05.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: send-UDP request via the user interface (src_port = K)

2. Observation:
   • DUT → Tester: UDP datagram
     - src_port == K   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted UDP carries src_port = K.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_wrong_src_port — DUT emitted UDP with a different src_port
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit any UDP within the listen window

verdicts.Pass: DUT-emitted UDP carries the requested src_port — normal
verdicts.Fail_wrong_src_port: DUT emitted UDP with the wrong user-interface src_port
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT-originated UDP within the listen window
